text:
Insist on your embrace,

redouble your fury,

create a space of insults

between I and the mirror,

create a leper woman’s song

between I and the woman I believe myself to be.

translation.title: Insist on Your Embrace…
translation.editorial_note: The nonstandard entre yo is intentionally carried into between I, keeping the grammatical split between speaker, reflection, and imagined self.
